status.description: Whether the governed production observation supports the production claim it was gathered for.

ticket_gap_outcome.description: How Squadron exposes a production-evidence gap. needs_human means a person can supply the missing evidence; insufficient_production_evidence records that no supported production conclusion is available.

claim.description: The narrow production fact this observation was intended to establish.

catalog_objects.description: The governed catalog views or tables queried.

query_reference.description: A stable identifier or location for the bounded read-only query. The checkpoint does not contain raw query output.

conclusion.description: The domain fact supported by the observation. When no conclusion is supported, state whether no rows matched, access failed, history was incomplete, or the result was truncated.

ticket_gap_reason.description: What evidence is missing, why it matters, and whether local investigation can continue. Empty when ticket_gap_outcome is none.
